messages:
Maria (AM): Quick sync — FinReg prospect wants EU-only data residency for the POC but will accept APAC failover for latency reasons. Need confirmation on: sub-processors in EU/APAC, certs we can provide, and the pricing delta between a hard region pin vs a soft preference. POC kicks off Mon. @Oliver can you advise?
Oliver (Solutions Eng): We support per-tenant routing policies. Two common patterns: hard_pin (traffic locked to region, no cross-region egress) vs soft_preference (prefer EU, fallback to closest compatible region if capacity/latency demand). We also should clarify Hosted vs Dedicated implications.
Kai (Platform Eng): Tech note: Hosted supports both policies. hard_pin -> requests routed only to EU pools; we enforce via routing table + deny-list for other regions. soft_preference -> route to EU if available; if saturated we route to APAC compatible model variant. Fallback introduces a small token reissue and ~10-50ms extra latency. Example config we give customers: 
```json
{"tenant_id":"finreg-001","routing_policy":"hard_pin","preferred_regions":["eu-central-1"],"allow_fallback":false}
```
James (Legal): Need full subprocessor inventory (compute, logging, CDN) scoped by region. Also clarify KMS/HSM usage — customer requires EU KMS for keys at rest. They also want confirmation that logs/metrics used for billing won’t be exported outside EU.
Nina (SRE): Short answer: for Hosted, control-plane metadata (very small) currently touches our control plane in us-west for telemetry; payload & persistent logs can be kept in-region if requested. For Private/Dedicated we can ensure full EU-only flow. I'll validate what fields appear in control-plane telemetry and whether we can redact.
Maria (AM): Pricing/ops questions from customer: how much uplift for hard_pin on Hosted vs default routing? And how long to provision an EU Dedicated pool for a ~2 week POC?
Oliver (Solutions Eng): Ballpark numbers: hard_pin on Hosted is typically a ~15-25% per-token uplift because we reserve capacity and reduce cross-tenant multiplexing. Dedicated is a monthly committed lease — for a small POC (1-2 GPUs) you can expect a pro-rated minimum; I'll pull exact numbers. Provisioning EU Dedicated: if capacity available, ~3-7 business days; if not, we can emulate with soft_preference + capacity canary in EU.
Kai (Platform Eng): Subprocessor/cert note: we have SOC2 + ISO27001 and a DPA template. Subprocessors: GCP (eu-central-1) for compute, Fastly for CDN (configurable), and an EU-region S3 for artifacts. If APAC fallback is enabled we may use GCP asia-southeast1 — we list that in the subproc doc. Link: https://redwood.example.com/subprocessors (sent to customer in NDA pack).
James (Legal): I'll attach the DPA addendum and a short clause for EU-only routing (customer wants it in the contract). Also confirm we can provide audit logs export (redacted if needed).
Maria (AM): Customer also asked: will enabling hard_pin block all third-party CDNs by default? Any performance/regression risk?
Nina (SRE): By default CDN usage is still allowed if the CDN is configured for EU endpoints. If CDN would egress outside EU we mark it as non-compliant. We should surface that in the POC checklist. Performance-wise, hard_pin can increase variance if EU pool is busy — recommend a small reserved Dedicated pool for predictable latency.
Oliver (Solutions Eng): Action items: I’ll produce a short POC runbook with config snippet, expected uplift numbers, and a checklist for CDN/key management. Will also include an example routing_policy JSON and a canary plan.
deploy-bot: Reminder — POC workspace reservation for "finreg-001" expires in 48h: https://console.redwood.example.com/workspaces/finreg-001 (extend if needed).
James (Legal): I'll upload the DPA addendum + subproc spreadsheet to the shared folder by EOD.
Maria (AM): Great — owners: @James -> DPA & subproc list, @Nina -> confirm control-plane telemetry fields and logs residency, @Kai -> verify exact % uplift & re-provision timeline, @Oliver -> POC runbook + config. We should have a customer-facing summary by tomorrow morning.
Oliver (Solutions Eng): I'll draft the runbook and link the cost calc spreadsheet here once ready: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/POC-costs :thumbsup:
Maria (AM): Thanks team — I'll update the customer after we have the docs.
